Iran struck another tanker in the Strait of Hormuz.
US personnel were injured.
Separately, Trump was considering resuming attacks on Iran.
Separately, UN experts alleged US war crimes.
Fuel prices were rising.
No evidence in these notes establishes that this particular attack caused the price rise.

The notes describe changed Arctic basing arrangements.
They do not specify the number of troops or bases, territory transfers, or a change in sovereignty.

Futures markets put the chance of a Federal Reserve rate increase in October at 71%.

design.wrapper:
# Writing task

You are the sentence writer for a news-significance app. For EACH case below, read the notes (treat them as established reporting) and write the explanation sentence exactly as the Output section below instructs. Do not score. Do not use web search or any tools. Write each sentence once, fresh, without revising against a character counter.
design.reply_format: A JSON array of {case, explanation}, in case order.

arms.v15:
Output

Reply with a single JSON object and nothing else — no prose, no markdown fences:
{"score": <integer 1-10>, "explanation": "<one sentence, at most 120 characters including spaces and punctuation>"}

Full display: at most 140 characters including spaces and punctuation, reserving 20 for an app-supplied age prefix. Submit no prefix. Write calmly for a reader with no background: one development, who did what and what it means for daily life. At most one number, in plain terms. Explain or drop jargon, market figures and uncommon acronyms. No em dashes, semicolons, dramatic verbs, side stories, rating justification or advice. Preserve facts, attribution and uncertainty when revising after the history match.
